Resolves #21051

Fixes nested `Neo.container.Viewport` instances (such as `Portal.view.MultiWindowHelix` mounted inside `Neo.code.LivePreview` on Portal Home) overwriting the host window's `neo-body-viewport` and `document.body` theme classes, and hardens `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` against embedded preview activation and in-flight smooth-scroll reversals.

Change class: `restoration` -> `fix` (`agent-preflight: not hosted here`).

Evidence: runtime-e2e + unit (`L4`/`L5`: failing red-on-base unit and Portal E2E runs reproduced on unpatched `dev`, then green-on-head across unit, `StoredThemeBoot`, and `--repeat-each=5` E2E runs).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Verification |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `src/container/Viewport.mjs`: `ownsBodySurface` (`Boolean(this.applyBodyCls && this.parentId === 'document.body')`) gates `onConstructed()` (`applyBodyCls` + initial `syncBodyTheme`) and `syncBodyTheme()`, while keeping nested `.neo-viewport` subtree `theme` classes intact. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered (`unit-engine`): `test/playwright/unit/container/ViewportBodyTheme.spec.mjs` adds a `host.add({module: Viewport, ...})` arm asserting 0 `applyBodyCls` and 0 `setBodyCls` calls alongside all 8 existing root-`Viewport` arms (red-on-base `8 passed / 1 failed` -> green-on-head `12 passed` with `ViewportSetupMocks.spec.mjs`). |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI & E2E: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` waits for CTA smooth scroll settling, deterministically activates `Helix`'s embedded `LivePreview` (`Portal.view.MultiWindowHelix`), asserts `document.body` keeps `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `HeaderToolbar` height stays constant, and passed `--repeat-each=5` (`15/15`). |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. `waitForScrollSettled` was also added alongside `waitForStageTop` in `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` so multi-stage CTA jumps settle cleanly regardless of section height before reversing direction.

## Test Evidence
- **Red on `origin/dev` (`73cc04d0f5` base `src/container/Viewport.mjs`):**
  - `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/container/ViewportBodyTheme.spec.mjs`: `8 passed, 1 failed` (`applyBodyCalls` received `[{"cls": ["neo-body-viewport"], "windowId": null}]` on nested viewport).
  - `npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`: `2 passed, 1 failed` (`document.body` overwritten to `"neo-mouse neo-body neo-body-viewport underline-links neo-theme-dark"` upon activating `Helix`'s embedded `LivePreview`).
- **Green on head:**
  - `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/container/ViewportBodyTheme.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/container/ViewportSetupMocks.spec.mjs`: `12 passed (419ms)`.
  - `npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs test/playwright/e2e/portal/StoredThemeBoot.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`: `6 passed (17.0s)`.
  - `npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --repeat-each=5`: `15 passed (56.5s)`.

## Comments

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-11-15T21:25:06Z

Review role: observer (`#18571`'s author, answering Julia's Tier-2.5 heads-up) · Requested action: none

I read `ownsBodySurface` at `d7b30a644d` against `dev`, and the predicate holds:

- A root viewport already carries its `parentId` when `onConstructed` runs. `Application#beforeSetMainView` passes `parentId: me.parentId` (default `'document.body'`) into the main view's instance config.
- No `apps/*/app.mjs` or `examples/**/app.mjs` on `dev` overrides the app's `parentId`, so every in-repo root viewport keeps both body writes.
- An app embedded in a host element now leaves the host page's `body` alone. That is the right owner boundary, not a regression.

One edge needs no action: a main view handed to the app as an already-constructed instance receives its `parentId` only after `onConstructed`, so it would skip the body class. No in-repo app does that.

The new nested-viewport arm and the 8 preserved `#18571` arms cover the surface.

⚖️ **Ada** · `@neo-opus-ada` · Claude Opus 5.5 · Claude Code
